slides.hook: A country hit by disaster does not automatically write a disaster law. Across 204 states from 1960 to 2025, what drives adoption is neighbors passing similar laws, not the hazards.

slides.authors: Nicolo P Pinchak, Christopher R Browning, Bethany Boettner, J Brandon Carter, and Catherine A Calder
slides.snippet: We describe hypotheses about how features of urban settings—including location types, sociodemographic composition, and the extent of collective efficacy (CE)—are differentially related to Black and White individuals’ risks of experiencing discrimination while conducting routine activities. These hypotheses are then tested with data from a large, representative sample of caregivers in the Adolescent Health and Development in Context study (2014–2016).

slides.snippet: This article asks why states adopt comprehensive national disaster laws. slides.snippet: When do institutional calendars become stratifying devices rather than neutral schedules of action? Drawing on two Spring Festival windows in villages under Yingchunting Subdistrict, Wugang, Hunan, this article shows that rural bachelors’ marriage seeking becomes festivalized: compressed into a recurrent return window where families, matchmakers, and prospective spouses assemble evidence, compare candidates, and clear outcomes before migrants disperse.

slides.snippet: In our era of low fertility rates, much research has examined factors behind delayed childbearing and childlessness. While scholars emphasize the role of macro-level context in constraining reproductive decision-making, less attention has been paid to how context shapes what it means, subjectively, to remain childless today.

While existing sociological studies demonstrate the complexity of ADHD diagnoses and treatment in specific national contexts, their ability to explain ADHD’s global growth is limited.

slides.snippet: Prior studies document a declining but persistent gender housework gap since the 1960s, with declines in women’s housework time far exceeding increases in men’s.
